text: Handling Failed / Stuck Recharge Transactions Document ID: SOP_C03_RECHARGE_FAILURE Category: C03 — Recharge & Payments Department: Finance Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To define the standard procedure for diagnosing and resolving recharge transactions where payment was debited but not credited to the customer account. Scope Applies to all prepaid and postpaid recharge channels: app, web self-care, UPI, cards, net banking, and retail POS. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Verify the transaction reference ID and debit confirmation provided by the customer. Check transaction status in the Payment Reconciliation Dashboard. If status is 'Pending', advise the customer that auto-reconciliation typically completes within 60 minutes. If unresolved after 24 hours, raise a manual reconciliation ticket to the Payments Ops team. If the gateway confirms the debit but NovaTel has no record within 48 hours, process a goodwill account-balance credit pending final reconciliation, and flag for audit. Close the ticket only once the customer confirms plan/balance is credited, or the amount is refunded to source. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP.
title: Handling Failed / Stuck Recharge Transactions
